sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied concepcion-grande-elementary-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. South/east edge crowns and the distinguishable crown between the dark and green/yellow roofs; eastern exposed yard and narrow roof-edge links. The western green pocket by the restaurant and much of the north crown chain fall outside the complete mapped campus after local roof matching. The central green clump is a tree crown, with no distinguishable low bed or hedge; roof shadows are not hedges. The central green/yellow rectangle is a roof-like surface, not inferred lawn or a new court. The old match to the northern dark roof was incorrect; local sections use the central green roof and east/south classrooms. Continuous shared-vertex triangular mapping preserves each traced surface before mapped-obstacle clipping; no nearest-roof cell jumps. Entire roof osm:way/23677587 and all its observed corners are excluded from fitting and checked against the actual final mapping. Within-roof agreement is recorded separately and does not establish cross-roof accuracy. Independent roof errors exceed five metres, so the registration gate remains unmet. One withheld roof does not establish distributed campus-wide survey accuracy; differing older mapped roof dimensions/placements are retained, not edited. The image traces and recognizable canopy groups remain the observations; surface/trunk placement clears complete mapped records. Virtual outer mesh anchors come only from the all-used-control affine and are not independent evidence. Independent excluded check errors: 3.46 m, 3.30 m, 6.23 m, 6.97 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
